cards.explanation: The answer is False. Zechariah tells the angel, "I see a flying scroll… twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide." (Zechariah 5:2) That's far too big to hold in one hand, friends. I can't even keep a small cookie box steady, and this thing is up in the air.

The answer is curse. The angel says, "This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land…" (Zechariah 5:3) Then he says what it does: every thief will be removed, and every perjurer too. A perjurer is someone who swears falsely. This scroll is serious, friends.

The answer is everyone who lies under oath. The angel says one side is for "every thief" and the other is for "every perjurer." (Zechariah 5:3) A perjurer is someone who swears falsely, friends. In verse 4, the LORD of Hosts says it's the one who "…swears falsely by My name."

The answer is True. The LORD of Hosts says, "I will send it out… and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by My name. It will remain inside his house and destroy it…" (Zechariah 5:4) It goes in and it stays, friends. I hope nobody's wishing it would just pop in and leave.

The answer is that it destroys the house down to its timbers and stones. The LORD of Hosts says it "…will remain inside his house and destroy it, down to its timbers and stones." (Zechariah 5:4) Timbers are the wooden beams, friends. That's a thorough job.

The answer is a measuring basket. The angel says, "A measuring basket is going forth." (Zechariah 5:6) It's a basket, friends, not a jar or a chest. And the next verse shows what's inside that basket.

The answer is Wickedness. The angel says, "This is Wickedness…" (Zechariah 5:8) The woman sitting in the basket is named Wickedness, friends. Then he shoves her down into the basket and pushes the lead cover down over its opening.

The answer is that the angel shoves her down and shuts the lead cover. The angel "…shoved her down into the basket, pushing down the lead cover over its opening." (Zechariah 5:8) Down she goes and the lid comes down, friends. Lead is heavy, so I think that lid isn't coming off easy.

The answer is that they lift it up between heaven and earth. The text says the two women "…lifted up the basket between heaven and earth." (Zechariah 5:9) They do it with wind in their wings, friends. Up it goes, high in the air.

The answer is Shinar. The angel says, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar…" (Zechariah 5:11) Shinar is the land where the basket is going, friends. When it's ready, the basket will be set there on its pedestal.
